notes.title: Undo
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Undo
[list]
[*] You can undo actions up to the beginning of the current turn[/list][*] New layered music for menu and ingame
[*] New end game victory animations
[*] New animations for several enemies
[*] Improved potion effects and targeting behaviors
[*] Tangled Mass can no longer have Raging or Nullify anomalies
[*] Fixed a few issues with scrollbars
[*] Fixed an animation hitch that would happen while moving to the next act
[*] Fixed crashes with Treeskin Paint and Bird Skull relics
[*] Moved Card Compendium sorting/filter controls to the left side and made them controller friendly
[/list]

[h2]Mystic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Transmutation now retains Ether Shocks that are generated after ending your turn
[/list]

[h2]Dragoon[/h2]
[list]
[*] Surge renamed to Kinetic Dash
[*] Fixed Firebrand working on Invisible enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Healing, draws, and history
notes.content:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The number of non-move cards drawn per turn has been increased from 2 to 3
[*] Max hand size per hero has been increased from 6 to 7
[*] Starting decks now have one more basic attack and one more basic block
[*] The chance of finding a Card Remove Skitterbug has been increased by 20%
[*] The chance of seeing a Card Remove map node has been increased by 15%
[*] The maximum number of Card Remove map nodes you can see per act has been increased from 2 to 3
[*] The normal/elite battle heal reward now affects both heroes instead of only one.  Once you reach ascension 4 it affects only one hero.
[*] The campfire heal now affects both heroes instead of only one.  Once you reach ascension 7 it affects only one hero.
[*] Added Run History menu as well as run summaries at the end of the game
[*] New card art for several cards
[*] New animations for several enemies
[*] Spike Plants now trigger on all damage or when a unit impacts into them, and they now deal their triggered damage to adjacent units (instead of sending long range spikes in all directions).
[*] Sources that spawn on the ground try to appear on non-barrier tiles first, and only appear under a barrier if there are no other tile options
[*] Improved card info visibility when cards have banes or augments
[*] NPCs now only show the tiles they can attack when hovered while attacking
[*] Shell Knight can no longer have the Raging corruption
[*] Scorpiox can no longer have Lifelink corruption
[*] Fixed losing all Fervor if its value is temporarily 0
[*] Fixed some cases of cards playing out of order
[*] DPad can now be used for tile targeting
[*] DPad now first hovers cards rather than immediately targeting them
[/list]

[h3]Mystic[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resupply now triggers after card play
[/list]

[h3]Phantom[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues with Whirling Dervish targeting
[/list]

notes.title: Events, ascensions, and an elite!
notes.content:
v0.39.0

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] All events now have art and most have had their choices reworked
[*] Added new elite fight to Act 2
[*] Added a simple map reveal animation to the beginning of acts
[*] Blind Recluse health reduced by 200
[*] Beholder health reduced by 200 and now summons 1 fewer tentacles before Ascension 8
[*] Targeting Projectile and Directional cards now shows an arrow near the hero showing the targeted direction
[*] Fixed crash if pressing DPad directions before combat starts
[*] Reduced likelihood of getting the same combat twice in a row
[/list]

[h2]Ascensions[/h2]
[list]
[*] For Ascensions 1-5, Ascension progress is unlocked for all hero combinations
[*] Ascensions 6-10 are now known as “Heroic Ascensions” and get unlocked for each unique hero pairing
[/list]

[h2]Phantom[/h2]
[list]
[*] Acrobatics: energy cost 2 -> 1, upgrade makes it innate
[*] Backstab: damage 6+6(9+9) -> 6+8(9+11)
[*] Drifter’s Gift: rarity changed from rare to uncommon
[*] Fan of Knives: now has a wide conical shape; upgrade increases Exposed 1 -> 2 and increases damage from 6 to 8
[*] Gloaming: energy cost 2(1) -> 1(0)
[*] Heavy Chakram: now counts for all generated cards this combat;  damage per generated card from 5(7) to 2(3)
[*] Lizard Kick: damage 8(11) -> 9(12)
[*] Shrouded Blades: Costs X and grants Phantom X+2 Kunais. Upgrade gives X+3 Kunais.
[*] Pacify: when you apply intimidate, you apply -1 Fervor this turn
[*] Stygian Bomb: damage 20(28) -> 24(32)
[*] Trickster’s Veil: now works with defense and block runes
[*] Whirling Dervish: now a projectile; deals 7 damage and applies 2 Feeble and chains to 2(4) additional targets
[/list]

[h2]Dragoon[/h2]
[list]
[*] Heads Up: now a Dragoon card (was Phantom), block increased from 5(8) -> 6(9)
[/list]

notes.title: Encounter Balance Update
notes.content:
Our first update since releasing into Early Access focuses on improving balance of a few particularly lethal encounters. Here's the full list of changes:

[h1]v0.36.0[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the lethality of a number of encounters
[list]
[*] Notable changes include: Act 2 and 3 bosses, as well as certain normal encounters that were nearly as deadly as elite encounters[/list]
[*] Increased the chance of finding higher rarity cards slightly
[*] New art for Greater Letch and Vessel Carrier creatures
[*] Fixed air elemental reposition sometimes causing units to occupy the same tile or the hero being sent into the void
[*] Fixed crash when killing last enemy with a potion
[*] Fixed Fade teleporting hero to nowhere if no tile is available
[*] Fixed Curved Mirror duplicating Blind Recluse’s curses
[*] Fixed not being able to taunt Blind Recluse when he was targeting a hero with Imprison
[*] Spiral Carapace will only show up if Dragoon is in the party
[*] Dreamer no longer offers an early Rune option
[*] Improved wording of some card and relic tooltips
[*] Skittering bounty: Skitterbug kill requirement reduced from 8 to 6
[*] Removed the Reset Progress button/functionality, will be re-added in a better spot in the future
[*] Fixed Phantom compendium not being visible after unlocking the Phantom
[*] Added 4k resolution as an option
[/list]

[h2]Map Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Card Blooms always offer an Attack, Skill, or Power (previously they offered three random cards)
[*] Move Shrines are more likely to appear
[/list]

[h2]Dragoon Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Amass: changed its upgrade to 3 Force gained per Power and Amass now counts Power cards from any hero’s deck (not just the target hero’s deck)
[*] Rock ‘Em Sock ‘Em: energy cost reduced from 3 to 2; the upgrade increases its bonus Knockback to all attacks from 1 to 2
[*] Stalagmites: energy cost reduced from 2 to 1; spike amount reduced from 5(7) to 4(6)
[/list]

[h2]Mystic Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cataclysm: Energy cost reduced from 3 to 2; now deals 4 damage and 1 Knockback 3 times (upgrade: 4 times)
[*] Endless Tome: energy cost reduced from 2(1) to 1(0)
[*] Haze: increased block gain per Exhaust from 3(4) to 3(5)
[/list]
